crossRefs.note: Fools mock at making atonement for sins, but among the upright there is good will.
Folly is joy to one who is void of wisdom, but a man of understanding keeps his way straight.
Like a madman who shoots torches, arrows, and death,
is the man who deceives his neighbor and says, “Am I not joking?”

translations.web: It is a fool’s pleasure to do wickedness, but wisdom is a man of understanding’s pleasure.
translations.bsb: The fool delights in shameful conduct, but a man of understanding has wisdom.
translations.kjv: It is as sport to a fool to do mischief: but a man of understanding hath wisdom.
translations.asv: It is as sport to a fool to do wickedness; And so is wisdom to a man of understanding.
